_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or computed here from values that were.

wind_mw.basis: the Briscoe Wind Farm's size in MW, per Soluna

dorothy_mw.basis: the older Dorothy campus in MW, built behind the meter, per Soluna

energized_mw.basis: Dorothy 1 and 2 energized capacity in MW, per Soluna on September 14th

d3_mw.basis: Dorothy 3, the next phase, in MW, up to this, per Soluna

phase1_mw.basis: Phase 1 of Dorothy 3 in MW of critical IT, per Soluna

applied_pct.basis: Applied's expected share of the project company, per Soluna

soluna_pct.basis: Soluna's expected share of the project company, per Soluna

acres_first.basis: acres Soluna first identified for the campus

acres_extra.basis: computed: acres bought minus acres first identified

extra_request_mw.basis: a further load request at the Dorothy campus in MW, under study, per Soluna

d3_over_wind.basis: computed: Dorothy 3's planned MW over the wind farm's MW, to two decimals

d3_minus_wind.basis: computed: MW by which Dorothy 3's plan exceeds the wind farm's size

energized_pct_of_wind.basis: computed: energized MW over the wind farm's MW, as a whole percent

phase1_pct_of_d3.basis: computed: Phase 1's MW over Dorothy 3's planned MW, as a whole percent

campus_planned_mw.basis: computed: the older campus's MW plus Dorothy 3's planned MW

campus_over_wind.basis: computed: the two campuses' MW over the wind farm's MW, to two decimals

section_mw.basis: the drawing unit: megawatts one tower section stands for on the deck's columns. A choice, not a claim

sections_wind.basis: computed: the wind farm's MW in sections

sections_d3.basis: computed: Dorothy 3's planned MW in sections

sections_phase1.basis: computed: Phase 1's MW in sections, a whole count when the unit divides it

bays_dorothy.basis: computed: the older campus's MW in bays at the same unit

bays_energized.basis: computed: energized MW in bays at the same unit

side_m_acres.basis: computed: the side in metres of a square of the acres bought

side_m_first.basis: computed: the side in metres of a square of the acres first identified
